records.source_statement: Waning Moon in second/last quarter, away from Sun beams yet beholding ascendant is said to show quicker/easier return.
Venus occidental, retrograde and hastening to combustion is read as a woman regretting separation and wishing to return.
Venus lately separated from Sun's beams is interpreted as man's regret, with woman perhaps returning resentfully.
limitations: Different personal regret and later respect claims.
